notes.title: Mr.Wise Long Demo Has Been Released!
notes.content:
Mr.Wise Long Demo Has Been Released!

With it's nearly one hour of gameplay time and two different endings; it showcases a small glimpse of what we're up to with our narrative game stories.

If you like the demo, you may kindly wishlist the game to show your appreciation.

We're hoping you to enjoy the demo and leave feedbacks so we can further improve both the story and the game itself.

Don't forget to follow us on our Steam Page for our other titles.
